purpose: ALISHA software factory: continuously verify, diagnose, repair and improve builds using multiple independent coding agents and objective quality gates.
principles: GitHub is the source of truth
No agent can self-certify its own work
Every fix must reproduce the failure and add or update a regression test where practical
Use golden blueprints and proven components before generating new architecture
Run autonomous code in isolated workspaces
Production changes require passing quality gates and governed promotion
The repair loop is event-driven and persistent, not a permanently busy GPU process

openSourceAgents.name: OpenAI Symphony
openSourceAgents.role: persistent work orchestration, issue intake, isolated workspace lifecycle and coding-agent dispatch
openSourceAgents.commercialGate: verify current Apache-2.0 repository licence and dependencies before commercial release

openSourceAgents.name: OpenHands
openSourceAgents.role: principal autonomous implementation and repair agent

openSourceAgents.name: Goose
openSourceAgents.role: independent developer, reviewer and repair challenger using local or approved external models
openSourceAgents.commercialGate: verify current Apache-2.0 repository licence and dependencies before commercial release

openSourceAgents.name: Cline
openSourceAgents.role: IDE/headless specialist agent for delegated coding, terminal work and parallel worktrees
openSourceAgents.commercialGate: verify current project and dependency licences before commercial release

alishaOwnedControllers.role: accept requirement, select blueprint, decompose work, assign agents, track evidence and govern promotion
consume failures from CI, staging, production, runtime logs and monitoring; reproduce, classify, repair, retest and open governed PRs
versioned golden application architectures for web, mobile, game, AI, portal, CRM, marketplace, document and internal-admin products
catalogue proven reusable auth, RLS, navigation, upload, email, payments, AI chat, permissions, audit, document and UI components
objective release proof across compile, types, lint, unit, integration, DB/RLS, API, browser, mobile, visual, security, accessibility, performance and smoke tests
normalise application, CI, runtime, deployment, security, performance and visual failures into actionable repair events

agentRoles.frontendSpecialist: ALISHA-selected OpenHands/Goose worker with frontend blueprint
agentRoles.backendSpecialist: ALISHA-selected OpenHands/Goose worker with backend blueprint
agentRoles.databaseSpecialist: ALISHA-selected worker constrained by Supabase/Postgres/RLS standards
agentRoles.mobileSpecialist: ALISHA-selected worker using React Native/Expo/Capacitor route
agentRoles.repairEngineer: continuous repair controller + selected independent coding agent
agentRoles.finalReviewer: independent model/agent that did not author the final implementation

repairLoop: identify repository, release and owning capability
create or update failing regression test where practical
record incident, cause, fix and reusable lesson
completionRule: A job is not COMPLETE because an AI says it is complete. COMPLETE requires objective evidence that all applicable quality gates passed.
